name: Stockroom
tagline: Point of sale and inventory for a small independent shop
description: For the owner of a small shop who rings up sales and orders stock from the same counter. It keeps the till, the shelves and the supplier orders in one exact record, in the browser, with no account or server.
scope: Keyboard-first register with discounts, tax and cash change
Stock ledger, refunds and purchase orders with average cost
Margin reports and end-of-day cash count
features: Register with search, category tabs, SKU and barcode entry, hold and resume, and F-key shortcuts
Line and order discounts with tax worked out in integer cents, plus an 80mm print receipt
Append-only stock ledger covering sales, restocked refunds, adjustments and PO receipts
Purchase orders from draft to partial to received, with one-click reorder from low stock alerts
Revenue, gross margin and top seller reports by day, product and category in hand-built SVG charts
End-of-day count by note and coin with over or short, CSV exports, and JSON backup and restore
engineering: Order discounts and tax are allocated to sale lines by largest remainder, and refunds difference cumulative shares, so repeated partial refunds always sum to the exact cents originally charged.
